verdict.rationale: Greenhouse publishes multiple documented public APIs (Harvest API for updating candidates/attachments/applications, Job Board API, Candidate Ingestion API, Assessment Partner API, and webhooks) with clear docs.greenhouse.io reference pages describing endpoints and payloads. This is a genuine, well-documented public API surface an AI-native user could drive programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/swagger returned 404s) and no llms.txt, which would make agentic consumption easier and more verifiable.
